items.reason: The relative clause “who spoke to the king” clearly identifies the woman. Her complaint that the other woman “had hidden him” supports the expected answer.
The single temporal clause “when the man of God prays” is clear. The passage explicitly says that the king’s hand was restored after his intercession.
The setup “王求神人为他祷告” gives away the requested identity in “谁为王祷告了”. Also, option A’s qualifier “从犹大来的” is not established in the supplied passage.
“是为了什么结果” is awkward phrasing that mixes purpose and result, obscuring the intended relation to “愿神也听你们的话”.
The question clearly asks who took the listed objects. “那五个窥探地的人进去，拿了” directly supports option C; the object list identifies the event rather than imposing list comparison.
The question clearly asks who commanded the specified army. “他们统领的军队” refers to the preceding “二千六百人”, supporting option D.

“After the man of God leaves” does not specify which departure: the passage describes both his departure from Bethel and his later departure after the meal. The intended lion encounter is supported, but the event setup needs clarification.
“最先” clearly distinguishes the five men’s initial removal of the images from the priest’s later taking them. The passage supports option C.
The actor question is direct, and “祭司就把……枪和盾牌交给百夫长” supports option C, with the priest identified as Jehoiada in the preceding verse.
The question directly asks the reason for speaking until midnight. “由于保罗第二天准备离开” explicitly supports option A.
